user.title: Connect MiniJ
user.description: Choose how to sign in. Phone/SMS login is experimental. An owner reports it works; session behavior and additional verification remain under validation.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MiniJ
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to the same MiniJ account. Existing devices and entity settings will be preserved.

phone.title: Request a MiniJ login code
phone.description: Enter the 11-digit mainland China phone number of your existing MiniJ account, without +86. Submitting sends one SMS. The owner’s App stayed signed in during one test; other accounts and session rotation remain unverified. SMS is never sent automatically.

sms.title: Enter SMS code
sms.description: Enter the code MiniJ sent you. Submitting exchanges the code once. To change the number or request another SMS, cancel and start again; avoid repeated requests.

validate.title: Check MiniJ account access
validate.description: Your code was accepted. Retry to check account and device access using the returned session. This does not send another SMS or exchange the code again.

token.title: Use a MiniJ session token
token.description: Enter a token from your own signed-in MiniJ account. During reauthentication it must belong to the original account.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect MiniJ
reconfigure.description: Sign in to the same MiniJ account. Existing devices and entity settings will be preserved.

error.invalid_auth: MiniJ rejected the session. Start again to sign in.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to MiniJ. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: MiniJ did not return a valid account identity.
error.no_devices: No appliances are bound to this MiniJ account. Bind an appliance in the MiniJ app, then retry.
error.invalid_phone: Enter an 11-digit mainland China mobile number without a country prefix.
error.invalid_code: Enter the numeric code from your SMS.
error.rate_limited: MiniJ is limiting requests. Wait before trying again; the server’s cooldown is unknown.
error.sms_rejected: MiniJ did not confirm a supported SMS response. A code may have been sent. Avoid repeated requests; use token setup if the service requires an app challenge.
error.sms_uncertain: The SMS request could not be confirmed. A code may have been sent. Check your messages and wait before submitting again.
error.login_rejected: MiniJ did not accept this login or requires an unsupported challenge. Check the code in your SMS; use token setup if app verification is required.
error.login_uncertain: The login result could not be confirmed. No automatic retry was made. Wait before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This MiniJ account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This login belongs to a different MiniJ account. Start reauthentication again using the original account.
abort.invalid_auth: MiniJ rejected the new session. Start again to sign in.
